title: Without DOCUMENT_MANAGE the tab still lists documents and offers no Upload button
steps: Create role D-NODOCMANAGE-MUA629XJ947E (DOCUMENT_VIEW, INVOICE_VIEW/MANAGE, no DOCUMENT_MANAGE); sign in as d-viewonly-mua629xs598f; open the invoice Documents tab
expected: The documents are listed; no Upload button, because POST /api/documents would 403
actual:
rows listed: 5; buttons on the tab: Notifications, Account
d-viewonly-mua629xs598f • D-NODOCMANAGE-MUA629XJ947E, Back, Save changes, Net 30, 2026-10-20, Refresh, Download, Download, Download, Download, Download

title: A user without DOCUMENT_MANAGE is told why they cannot upload
steps: Sign in as d-viewonly-mua629xs598f (no DOCUMENT_MANAGE); open the invoice Documents tab; read the tab header and the empty/list body for an explanation
expected: AC-C20: upload "disables itself with an explanation for users without DOCUMENT_MANAGE" — a disabled control, tooltip or line of text saying why
actual: The Upload button is simply absent and nothing on the tab explains why. Header shows only "Documents (5)" and a Refresh button; no permission wording anywhere on screen. The implementation doc records only "Buttons that would 403 are not shown (AC-C22)" (§4.6), so AC-C22 is met but AC-C20's explanation is missing.

title: Row actions without DOCUMENT_MANAGE are download-only — no Edit, no Remove
steps: As the no-DOCUMENT_MANAGE user, read the buttons on every document row
expected: Only Download per row (the API reports canEdit=false, canDelete=false)
actual: row buttons: Download, Download, Download, Download, Download

title: Dropping a file does nothing for a user who may not upload
steps: As the no-DOCUMENT_MANAGE user, drop a PNG on the Documents tab
expected: No upload form opens — the drop target is off for users who cannot upload

title: The no-DOCUMENT_MANAGE session makes no request the server refuses
steps: Collect every response >= 400 and every page error across the whole restricted session
expected: No 403 and no page error — nothing on screen leads to a refused request

title: A self-service customer sees only SHARED documents on their own invoice
steps: Sign in as the customer login d-cust-mua629r77a77; open their invoice's Documents tab (the invoice carries 1 SHARED and 4 INTERNAL documents)
expected: Only the SHARED row is listed, and the tab count matches
actual: rows on screen: d-signed-delivery-note.png; rows marked Internal: 0; API returned 1 row(s), 0 of them not SHARED

title: A customer login gets no edit or delete control on a shared document
steps: As the customer login, read the buttons on the shared document row
expected: Download only — PATCH and DELETE are 403 for a customer login

title: The customer upload control (a documented deviation from AC-C12) works and lands SHARED
steps: As the customer login, open the Documents tab; if an Upload control is offered, use it
expected: AC-C12 says no upload for a customer; the implementation doc (§4.5, answer 4) records a deliberate decision to allow it, with uploads forced to SHARED and no visibility choice. Either no control, or a control that works exactly that way.
actual: Upload offered; visibility dropdown shown: false; uploaded row: d-customer-evidence.pdf visibility=SHARED

title: The customer session makes no request the server refuses
steps: Collect every response >= 400 and page error across the customer session (list, upload)
